translation: In all cases where the scrotum (陰囊) is torn by a person, use egg yolk oil (雞子黃油) and the hairs of jinmao gouji (Cibotium, 金毛狗脊), spread them thinly and apply the oil on top, then apply fengkou medicine (封口藥, wound-closing medicine); also apply Jiexue Gao (Blood-Staunching Plaster, 截血膏), or Wulong Gao (Black Dragon Plaster, 烏龍膏) may also be applied. Administer Jiajian Zijin Dan (Modified Purple-Gold Pill, 加減紫金丹) internally, and wash with a decoction of Zisuye (Perilla leaf) boiled in water. In all cases where the scrotum has a blue-black-purple swelling, use Dingtong Gao (Pain-Relieving Plaster, 定痛膏) with a little each of Chishao (red peony), Caowu (Aconite kusnezoffii), Liangjiang (Alpinia), and Rougui (cinnamon) added and mixed together, and pound jiuye (leek leaves) thoroughly and apply together.
